title: Meta acquires AI device startup Limitless
content: Limitless said it shares Meta's vision of bringing personal superintelligence to everyone.

title: ChatGPT’s user growth has slowed, report finds
content: ChatGPT's global monthly active users only grew by around 5% from August to November, while Gemini's users grew by about 30%.

title: AWS re:Invent was an all-in pitch for AI. Customers might not be ready.
content: AWS is releasing a lot of new AI tech, but the cloud infrastructure giant's enterprise customers may not be ready for it yet.

title: eSIM adoption is on the rise thanks to travel and device compatibility
content: As a technology, eSIM has been around for a decade now. However, global eSIM adoption was around 3% last year and will only cross 5% this year. Despite these figures, analysts, eSIM-providing startups, and investors are bullish about eSIM's upward trajectory, largely thanks to travel.

title: New ‘KnoWay’ robotaxis cause chaos in upcoming Grand Theft Auto Online DLC
content: The inclusion of the Waymo look-a-likes appears to be part of a larger storyline that will encourage players to "stop the development of a mass surveillance network."

title: New streaming channel launches to give viewers a peek into city council meetings
content: Hamlet TV is a way to help keep citizens informed of what's happening inside local governments.

title: The New York Times is suing Perplexity for copyright infringement
content: The New York Times filed a copyright lawsuit against Perplexity, joining other publishers using legal action as leverage to force AI companies into licensing deals that compensate content creators.

title: Meta signs commercial AI data agreements with publishers to offer real-time news on Meta AI
content: Meta is partnering with CNN, Fox News, Fox Sports, Le Monde Group, the People Inc. portfolio of media brands, The Daily Caller, The Washington Examiner, and USA Today.

title: Energy storage industry set aggressive goals for 2025 — and already crushed them
content: The battery storage industry in the U.S. has grown in leaps and bounds in recent years, surpassing its most aggressive targets to become one of the largest new sources of power on the grid.

title: In its first DSA penalty, EU fines X €120M for ‘deceptive’ blue check verification system
content: The EC is taking issue with the fact that X, the social network formerly known as Twitter, has been allowing anyone to buy a "blue checkmark," the platform's long-standing symbol that a user has been verified to be who they are claiming to be.

title: Petco confirms security lapse exposed customers’ personal data
content: The pet company has published almost no details about what happened, who was affected, and what personal data was exposed.

title: Netflix to acquire Warner Bros. in a disruptive deal valued at $82.7B
content: In one of the most groundbreaking deals the streaming world has ever seen, Netflix acquires Warner Bros. for $82.7 billion.

title: Welcome to the big leagues, Netflix
content:
Warner Bros. has an infamous history of being bought by other companies and then quickly ending up back on the market after its new owners realize how difficult it is to capitalize on a legacy production studio's assets. title: Chamberlain blocks smart home integrations with its garage door openers — again
content:
Garage door opener manufacturer The Chamberlain Group has launched a new version of the communication platform that powers its connected garage door openers - and it's bad news for smart home users.

The new Security+ 3.0 platform, launching alongside Chamberlain's latest openers, shuts down the workarounds that third-party accessory makers such as Tailwind, Meross, and Ratgdo developed to let you integrate your garage door with Apple Home, Home Assistant, Amazon Alexa, Google Home, and others.
